title: Atmos™ Rewards adds GOL as newest global partner and broadens travel options to South America with GOL and American Airlines
summary: Starting today, guests can book select GOL flights on alaskaair.com and hawaiianairlines.com and earn Atmos points.
body_markdown:
In addition to its new partnership with GOL, Alaska continues to expand its partnership with American Airlines, bringing more destinations into the Alaska and Hawaiian booking experience. Soon, guests will be able to book additional journeys connecting Alaska and Hawaiian flights to South America on American, starting with Brazil and expanding to additional destinations in 2027. Guests from the West Coast will be able to fly Alaska and Hawaiian to New York, Dallas (DFW) and Miami (MIA) and connect to Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo (GRU) on American.


Guests earn Atmos points on all American Airlines flights. Atmos Rewards status holders will also receive all their typical status benefits when flying on American, including extra legroom seats and complimentary upgrades when available.


Beginning in 2027, Atmos Rewards members will be able to choose how they earn on partner flights, including GOL and American Airlines: by distance traveled, price paid or segments flown.


Alaska’s 30+ partners bring bucket-list travel within reach, giving guests more ways to see the world. Eligible partner flights can also bring Atmos Rewards members closer to status and the benefits that enhance their travel experience.
